page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

The underlying x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 vector extensions (AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16) and cryptographic acceleration (AES, VAES, and SHA_NI). These hardware-level capabilities assist with vector calculations, integer manipulation, and secure data processing. However, the processor lacks Intel-specific Advanced Matrix Extensions.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.g8ae.4xlarge demonstrates strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU tests placing it in the top 10% of its class and Geekbench single-core scores ranking in the top 25%. Conversely, multi-core performance metrics, such as stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core, fall into the average middle 50% range. Memory bandwidth tests, including uncached read and write operations, also align with mid-tier performance profiles.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a balanced resource density for workloads that benefit from high single-thread performance but do not require local NVMe storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent execution without resource contention. This profile is suitable for general-purpose application hosting, web serving, text processing, and database operations that rely on external storage volumes.
